$comment: S03 Open-Meteo GloFAS river discharge (T048). Measure columns added to the common envelope (common.json). Field map: configs/sources/s03.yaml.

fields.name: river_cell_id
fields.meaning: glofas_seamless_v4_<lat>N_<lon>E, the 0.05 degree GloFAS cell the API snapped to

fields.name: discharge_m3s
fields.meaning: river_discharge in m³/s; null where there is no river cell or no value

fields.name: member
fields.meaning: Ensemble member; null for the deterministic series

valid_at: Local midnight at the end of valid_date, in UTC
available_at: Fetch time; past values are a hindcast unless stored at issue time
missing: A null value stays null: not_yet_available after the newest value of the cell, otherwise out_of_coverage
